source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 22 April 1927, p. 12 ("Derry local elections: nominations received")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: BNL 22 Apr 1927 p12 'Limavady', read in the block image (areas 9-10): nomination list with labels; BNL 29 Apr 1927 p7: 17 nominations for 16 vacancies, the seven other retiring members deemed re-elected, no withdrawal in Straw.

note: Triennial election of Limavady rural district (23 divisions, one member each). Seventeen nominations were received for sixteen divisions; the seven divisions with no nomination (Ballyhargan, Ballykelly, Bellarena, Benone, Drum, Faughanvale and Killywool) had their retiring members deemed re-elected (Belfast News-Letter, 22 and 29 April 1927), but those members are not named in the reports read; three are recorded from reports of the new council's meetings (meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Straw was the only contest. Polled Friday 27 May 1927: 'Polling took place yesterday in the Bellarena division of county Londonderry, the only division in the county where there was a contest' for the county council (Londonderry Sentinel, Saturday 28 May 1927, p. 8), and the Limavady rural contest in Straw 'took place on Friday' (Derry Journal, 30 May 1927, p. 8). Returned unopposed.
